# npnp v2.0.0

> npnp's export pipeline is now aligned with SeEx 2.0.0. The command line is
> unchanged: the same commands and options work, and existing libraries keep
> working.

## Added

- `npnp kicad` accepts `--append`, matching `npnp altium`: the components are
  added to the library already in the output directory instead of the export
  owning that directory.
- A component that has not answered within 180 seconds is failed and skipped,
  so one stuck part can no longer hold an entire batch.

## Fixed

- A repeated KiCad export re-downloaded everything whenever `--force` was on.
  The checkpoint is the record of what has already been exported into the
  library, so it now decides what to skip; `--force` only says to replace
  entries that are already there.
- Appending into a merged library that had been marked read-only failed with a
  bare "access is denied" that never named the file. The read-only flag is
  cleared first, and on Unix only the owner's write bit is added — clearing
  every write bit at once would leave the library world writable.
- A batch could crawl for minutes and then fail parts while `easyeda.com`
  refused every request (403 and an HTML page) for a whole network. That
  refusal now sends the request to the `lceda.cn` mirror, which serves the same
  component API, instead of holding the entire batch in a 45 second cooldown.
  The 264-id batch that reported the stall went from six minutes with 42
  failures to 48 seconds with none.
- The progress bar only moved when a part finished, and named the part that had
  just finished, so a run waiting on the store looked hung. It now names the
  part being fetched, counts beside it and the running totals, and only redraws
  when any of that changes.

## Changed

- A KiCad export now refuses to write into a library that already exists unless
  `--append` is given, instead of quietly merging into it. The error names the
  file and says what to do. This is the same rule the Altium export has always
  had for a merged library.
- The KiCad checkpoint file name now includes the library name
  (`.kicad_checkpoint_<library>_<targets>`), because two libraries in one
  directory are two different sets of exported ids. A checkpoint written by
  1.2.0 is ignored once, so the first export after upgrading fetches the ids
  again.

## Performance

- 3D models are no longer held in memory for the whole batch: each download goes
  into a scratch file, is corrected, and is then written into the library as a
  stream. Each part is reduced to the streams the merged library needs as soon
  as it is built, so exported parts stop keeping their structured data around.
- The merged library is written as a stream, with models in chunked zlib
  "stored" blocks.
- Model downloads ask for a compressed body (STEP is text and compresses several
  times over), and the HTTP client is shared process wide so connections are
  reused instead of a new client per call.
- Peak memory is now driven by `-j` rather than by the number of ids: lower `-j`
  for a lower peak, at the cost of time.

## Build

- CI and the release builds install the nightly toolchain, matching SeEx, so the
  formatter used by CI is the one used during development.
- The tree is formatted with nightly `rustfmt`.
- Clippy runs with the same gate as SeEx (`-D clippy::correctness -D
clippy::suspicious`).
- `tokio` 1.54.0, and `reqwest` now enables `gzip`.

## 中文

> npnp 的导出流水线已对齐到 SeEx 2.0.0。命令行没有变化：原有命令与参数依旧可用，
> 已有库也仍然可用。

### 新增

- `npnp kicad` 支持 `--append`，与 `npnp altium` 一致：把元件追加到输出目录里已有的库，
  而不是把该目录当作本次导出独占。
- 单个元件超过 180 秒仍未返回会被记为失败并跳过，一个卡住的元件不会再拖住整批导出。

### 修复

- 重复执行 KiCad 导出时，只要开了 `--force` 就会重新下载全部元件。检查点记录的是
  「哪些 ID 已经导出进这个库」，现在由它决定跳过哪些；`--force` 只表示替换库中已有的条目。
- 向被标记为只读的合并库追加时，只会得到一句「access is denied」，且不说明是哪个文件。
  现在会先清除只读属性，并且在 Unix 上只补上属主的写权限位——一次清掉所有写位会让库变成
  任何人可写。
- 当 `easyeda.com` 对整个网络拒绝请求（每个 ID 都返回 403 和 HTML 页面）时，批量会先卡上
  几分钟、再失败掉一部分。现在这种拒绝会改问 `lceda.cn` 镜像（同一套器件接口），而不是让
  整批停在 45 秒冷却里。报告卡住的那批 264 个 ID：从 6 分钟、42 个失败，变成 48 秒、全部成功。
- 进度条原本只在某个元件结束时才动，显示的又是刚结束的那个，所以等待上游时看起来像卡死。
  现在显示正在抓取的元件、旁边还有多少个、以及成功/跳过/失败计数，并且只在这些内容变化时重绘。

### 变更

- KiCad 导出不再静默合并进已存在的库：没有 `--append` 时会拒绝写入，并在错误里指出文件
  与处理方式。这条规则与 Altium 合并库一直以来的规则一致。
- KiCad 检查点文件名现在包含库名（`.kicad_checkpoint_<库名>_<目标>`），因为同一目录下的
  两个库是两套不同的已导出 ID。1.2.0 写下的检查点会被忽略一次，因此升级后的第一次导出会
  重新抓取这些 ID。

### 性能

- 3D 模型不再整批驻留内存：下载直接写入临时文件，校正后再以流的形式写入库；每个元件构建
  完成即转成合并库所需的流，已导出的元件不再保留结构化数据。
- 合并库改为流式写出，模型按 zlib stored 分块写入。
- 模型下载请求支持压缩传输（STEP 是文本，压缩后体积小很多），HTTP 客户端在进程内复用连接，
  不再为每次调用新建客户端。
- 内存峰值现在由 `-j` 决定，而不再随 ID 数量增长：想要更低的峰值可以调小 `-j`，代价是变慢。

### 构建

- CI 与发布构建改用 nightly 工具链，与 SeEx 保持一致，使 CI 使用的格式化器与开发时一致。
- 代码按 nightly `rustfmt` 重新格式化。
- Clippy 使用与 SeEx 相同的门槛（`-D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious`）。
- `tokio` 升级到 1.54.0，`reqwest` 启用 `gzip`。
